evaluation_target.rationale: The hazard describes the undesired event as the vehicle suddenly stopping without an obstacle in front, and SG-3 explicitly states that the system shall prevent unintended braking.

phenomenon_of_interest.statement: The vehicle braking behavior in the stated operational situation, including whether braking occurs without a valid external obstacle-related cause and whether braking is intended or unintended.
phenomenon_of_interest.scope: Straight ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, in good weather, with no visible obstacles or vehicles in front of the ego vehicle.
phenomenon_of_interest.rationale: The hazard fixes the operational situation and the hazardous event concerns a sudden stop with no obstacle in front; evaluating prevention of unintended braking requires characterizing braking behavior under that operating context.

distinctions.contrast_a: Braking occurs because an obstacle is present or detected in front of the ego vehicle.
distinctions.contrast_b: Braking occurs although no obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle.
distinctions.rationale: Collapsing these situations would lose the information needed to judge whether braking is unintended in the hazard scenario and therefore whether SG-3 is satisfied.

orrs.obligation: An admissible Observable Representation shall preserve whether braking is associated with the presence or detection of a relevant obstacle versus occurring when no obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must keep the two braking situations distinguishable: braking with a relevant obstacle present/detected and braking with no obstacle present in front of the vehicle.
